TITLE: Paperless-ngx
DESC: Paperless-ngx CLI for AI agents: list, search, read and download documents, and (policy-gated) upload, tag and update them over the REST API.
PLATFORMS: macOS, Linux and Windows; amd64 and arm64
SCOPE_HELP: document tags as `tag:<name>` (e.g. `tag:invoices`, `tag:agent-*`), or `untagged` for documents without tags
INJECTION: No shell and no scripts. Requests are built with `net/url` and `encoding/json` from typed parameters, and the only subprocess (`/usr/bin/security`, for the Keychain) gets fixed argv elements.
SECRETS: The API token comes from `PAPERLESS_TOKEN` or the macOS Keychain (keyed by the server URL), never from flags or arguments. It is never printed, logged or included in errors, and it is never sent to another host on a redirect.
NETWORK: except HTTPS requests to your own `PAPERLESS_URL`
ONELINER: Search, read, download and file Paperless-ngx documents from the command line, built for AI coding agents.
PERMISSION_HINT: The API token is missing or was rejected
DATA_NOUN: the documents in your Paperless-ngx archive
INTEGRATION_NOTE: The Paperless tests start a throwaway Paperless-ngx in Docker, run against it and remove it with all its data.
